mapper.select: SELECT S.WORD_ID AS "id", S.WORD_NM AS "nm", S.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "engAbrvNm", S.WORD_ENG_NM AS "extra", COALESCE(S.COMM_STND_YN, 'N') AS "commStndYn", CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_WORD T WHERE T.DICT_ID = #{targetDictId} AND (T.WORD_NM = S.WORD_NM OR T.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM = S.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM)) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "existYn" FROM TB_WORD S WHERE S.DICT_ID = #{sourceDictId} AND S.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND S.COMM_STND_YN = 'Y' AND (S.WORD_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR S.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY S.WORD_NM LIMIT 2000

SELECT S.TERMS_ID AS "id", S.TERMS_NM AS "nm", S.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "engAbrvNm", COALESCE(S.DOMAIN_NM, '') || CASE WHEN S.CODE_GRP IS NOT NULL THEN ' (코드 ' || S.CODE_GRP || ')' ELSE '' END AS "extra", COALESCE(S.COMM_STND_YN, 'N') AS "commStndYn", CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_TERMS T WHERE T.DICT_ID = #{targetDictId} AND (T.TERMS_NM = S.TERMS_NM OR T.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM = S.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM)) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "existYn" FROM TB_TERMS S WHERE S.DICT_ID = #{sourceDictId} AND S.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND S.COMM_STND_YN = 'Y' AND (S.TERMS_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR S.TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY S.TERMS_NM LIMIT 2000

SELECT S.DOMAIN_ID AS "id", S.DOMAIN_NM AS "nm", '' AS "engAbrvNm", S.DATA_TYPE || CASE WHEN S.DATA_LEN IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || S.DATA_LEN || CASE WHEN COALESCE(S.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN, 0) > 0 THEN ',' || S.DATA_DECIMAL_LEN ELSE '' END || ')' ELSE '' END AS "extra", COALESCE(S.COMM_STND_YN, 'N') AS "commStndYn", CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_DOMAIN T WHERE T.DICT_ID = #{targetDictId} AND T.DOMAIN_NM = S.DOMAIN_NM) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "existYn" FROM TB_DOMAIN S WHERE S.DICT_ID = #{sourceDictId} AND S.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND S.COMM_STND_YN = 'Y' AND S.DOMAIN_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY S.DOMAIN_NM LIMIT 2000
SELECT DOMAIN_ID AS "id", DOMAIN_NM AS "nm", DOMAIN_GRP_NM AS "grpNm", DOMAIN_CLSF_NM AS "clsfNm", DICT_ID AS "dictId" FROM TB_DOMAIN WHERE DOMAIN_ID = #{id}
SELECT DOMAIN_ID FROM TB_DOMAIN WHERE DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND DOMAIN_NM = #{nm}
SELECT WORD_ID AS "wordId", WORD_NM AS "wordNm", WORD_ORD AS "wordOrd" FROM TB_TERMS_WORDS WHERE TERMS_ID = #{id} ORDER BY WORD_ORD
SELECT WORD_ID AS "id", WORD_NM AS "nm", WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM AS "engAbrvNm" FROM TB_WORD WHERE DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND WORD_NM = #{nm}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_WORD WHERE DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM = #{engAbrvNm}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TERMS WHERE DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND (TERMS_NM = #{nm} OR TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM = #{engAbrvNm})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DOMAIN_GRP WHERE DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND DOMAIN_GRP_NM = #{nm}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DOMAIN_CLSF WHERE DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND DOMAIN_CLSF_NM = #{nm}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TERMS WHERE DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_WORD (WORD_ID, WORD_NM, WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM, WORD_ENG_NM, WORD_DESC, WORD_CLSF_YN, DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, ALLOPH_SYNM_LST, FORBDN_WORD_LST, COMM_STND_YN, MAGNTD_ORD, APRV_YN, APRV_USER_ID, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, APRV_STAT_UPDT_DT, USE_YN, DICT_ID) SELECT #{newId}, WORD_NM, WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM, WORD_ENG_NM, WORD_DESC, WORD_CLSF_YN, DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, ALLOPH_SYNM_LST, FORBDN_WORD_LST, 'Y', MAGNTD_ORD, 'Y', #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), USE_YN, #{targetDictId} FROM TB_WORD WHERE WORD_ID = #{srcId}

INSERT INTO TB_DOMAIN_GRP (DOMAIN_GRP_ID, DOMAIN_GRP_NM, COMM_STND_YN, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, DICT_ID, SORT_ORDER) VALUES (#{newId}, #{nm}, 'Y', to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}, #{targetDictId}, 0)

INSERT INTO TB_DOMAIN_CLSF (DOMAIN_CLSF_ID, DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, DOMAIN_GRP_NM, COMM_STND_YN, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, DICT_ID) VALUES (#{newId}, #{nm}, #{grpNm}, 'Y', to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}, #{targetDictId})
mapper.select: SELECT DOMAIN_GRP_NM FROM TB_DOMAIN_CLSF WHERE DICT_ID = #{sourceDictId} AND DOMAIN_CLSF_NM = #{nm}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DOMAIN (DOMAIN_ID, DOMAIN_NM, DOMAIN_GRP_NM, DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, DOMAIN_DESC, DATA_TYPE, DATA_LEN, DATA_DECIMAL_LEN, DATA_UNIT, STOR_FMT, EXPR_FMT_LST, COMM_STND_YN, ALLOW_VAL_LST, MAGNTD_ORD, APRV_YN, APRV_USER_ID, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, APRV_STAT_UPDT_DT, USE_YN, DICT_ID, PRIV_YN, ENCR_YN) SELECT #{newId}, DOMAIN_NM, DOMAIN_GRP_NM, DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, DOMAIN_DESC, DATA_TYPE, DATA_LEN, DATA_DECIMAL_LEN, DATA_UNIT, STOR_FMT, EXPR_FMT_LST, 'Y', ALLOW_VAL_LST, MAGNTD_ORD, 'Y', #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), USE_YN, #{targetDictId}, PRIV_YN, ENCR_YN FROM TB_DOMAIN WHERE DOMAIN_ID = #{srcId}

INSERT INTO TB_TERMS (TERMS_ID, TERMS_NM, TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM, TERMS_DESC, DOMAIN_NM, CODE_GRP, CHRG_ORG, ALLOPH_SYNM_LST, COMM_STND_YN, MAGNTD_ORD, APRV_YN, APRV_USER_ID, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, APRV_STAT_UPDT_DT, USE_YN, DICT_ID, PRIV_YN, ENCR_YN, CODE_TP, PARENT_CODE_GRP) SELECT #{newId}, TERMS_NM, #{engAbrvNm}, TERMS_DESC, DOMAIN_NM, CODE_GRP, CHRG_ORG, ALLOPH_SYNM_LST, 'Y', MAGNTD_ORD, 'Y', #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), USE_YN, #{targetDictId}, PRIV_YN, ENCR_YN, #{codeTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{parentCodeGrp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM TB_TERMS WHERE TERMS_ID = #{srcId}
INSERT INTO TB_TERMS_WORDS (TERMS_ID, WORD_ID, WORD_NM, WORD_ORD) VALUES (#{termsId}, #{wordId}, #{wordNm}, #{wordOrd})
